name: Cervical Isometric Flexion
steps: Sit or stand tall with good posture, relaxed shoulders, and your head in a neutral position.
Place the palm of one or both hands flat against your forehead.
Gently press your forehead forward into your palm as if attempting to nod your head forward.
Simultaneously press back with your hand using equal force so your head does not move at all.
Maintain this static isometric contraction for 5 to 10 seconds while breathing normally.
Slowly release the pressure, relax for 2 seconds, and repeat.
coaching_cues: Use only moderate effort (about 30-50% maximum effort); do not strain.
Your head must remain completely still in a neutral position throughout.
Keep your shoulders down and relaxed.
